newsitem.title: UK: Tay sees steady house recovery if rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Tay sees steady house recovery if rates flat.

text.p: The chairman of British housebuilder Tay Homes Plc, Trevor Spencer, said on Friday his company would expect the UK new homes market to keep recovering "if no further rate increases take place in the short term".

In a statement summarising his address to the company's annual meeting, Spencer said "I am pleased to report continued good sales and that we have maintained the 35 percent increase over last year's unit sales indicated (on) October 7...".
While he cautioned that achieving sales was still "very competitive" he said the recent quarter point interest rate rise "does not appear to have dampened the market".
If there were no further rate increases in the short term, this improvement should continue, "in which case the group is well-placed to achieve an improved performance in the current financial year".
